svg.text: I write mostly Python. On the geo side, GeoPandas and GeoPackage over
public data, like the CPRM/SGB risk sectors behind ORCA. On the vision
side, OpenCV pipelines (Canny edges, contour filters, frame by frame
tracking) from my master's research on slope monitoring. Lately also
some reverse engineering, reading a vendor's Windows tool so my keyboard
works on Linux. I keep tests where the logic is worth it and check
results against ground truth or an independent baseline like SAM 2,
because I do not trust my own numbers until something else agrees with
them. Still learning a lot of this as I go.
